Plugin.Name: UGREEN NAS Control
Plugin.Overview: Front LEDs, fan control and a live view of your UGREEN NAS (DX, DXP and iDX series) in Unraid. LEDs: colours, effects, drive and network status, night mode, Unraid alerts. Fans: Quiet, Standard, Performance or your own curves, with safety limits and a history graph; verified on the DXP4800 GT and DXP6800 Pro, reported working by users on the DXP2800, DXP2800 GT, DXP4800 Plus / Pro and DXP8800 Plus. Other models with a fan chip start with a guided fan detection and stay off until you confirm. Case view with bays, ports and drives; temperatures read from Unraid, so sleeping disks stay asleep. MQTT for Home Assistant and displays. Unraid 7.2 or newer, interface in 7 languages. No kernel module. Replaces UGREEN LED Control.
